Every STRUCTURE and BEHAVIOR cell in this column is therefore [R], derived from the APG tabs pattern and m3.material.io's published tabs guidance, and is flagged as such. provenance.edition-pin: PINNED TO tokens/versions/v0_192. OWNER DECISION: every M3 column pins the v0.192 edition, because material-web's own wrappers @use versions/v0_192 — and tokens/_md-comp-primary-tab.scss and _md-comp-secondary-tab.scss both read `@use 'versions/v0_192/md-comp-{primary,secondary}-navigation-tab'`. THE COUNTER-ARGUMENT THIS COLUMN RECORDED IS NOW THE DECISION, and the pin is LOSSY here in two places, both declared on their own cells. A full mechanical key/value diff finds ZERO divergences among the shared keys of either file; `latest` ADDS two families to both and v0.192 has neither. (a) THE DIVIDER PAIR — divider-height 1px / divider-color surface-variant — is gone. It arrived @deprecated in `latest` ('Use standalone divider component instead of nested tokens') but it was the ONLY source for the rule under the tab strip, so structure.tab-bar, prop.divider and style.tab-bar.divider are all declared gaps now. The slot `divider` (#e7e0ec / #49454f) was removed with them. (b) THE FOCUS-INDICATOR FAMILY — focus-indicator-color secondary, focus-indicator-thickness 3px, focus-indicator-outline-offset md-sys-state-focus-indicator.$inner-offset = -3px — is gone, and so is the _md-sys-state-focus-indicator.scss file it resolved through. For a keyboard-navigated component that could not be left as a gap: style.tab.focus is a LOCKED row. IT IS THEREFORE RE-POINTED, NOT DROPPED, to material-web's own hand-authored tokens/_md-comp-focus-ring.scss — the token set the shipped md-focus-ring element consumes, edition-independent because it @use's the top-level md-sys-color/md-sys-shape/md-sys-motion shims, all of which @use versions/v0_192. THE COLOUR AND THICKNESS SURVIVE EXACTLY ($color: md-sys-color.secondary = #625b71 / #ccc2dc; $width: 3px) BUT THE OFFSET CHANGES: focus-ring's $inward-offset is 0px where the tab's focus-indicator-outline-offset was -3px. M3's tab ring used to sit 3px INSIDE the tab edge and now sits flush on it. That is the one visible focus regression of this pin, and it is recorded on style.tab.focus rather than absorbed. WHAT ELSE CHANGES VALUE: the focus state-layer opacity, 0.1 -> 0.12 (see state-layer-opacities-are-edition-dependent). Everything else in this column — the label colours, the active-indicator geometry and colour, the typescale, container-height, elevation, icon size — is byte-identical across the editions.

Those are the v0.192 values (versions/v0_192/_md-sys-state.scss), and v0.192 is now the pinned edition — so the foundations page and this column agree, and the page was never wrong, only unlabelled. style.indicator.size.source: active-indicator-height 3px on the primary tab; the emphasis row reassigns it to 2px for secondary. Note this equals Salt's medium-density size-indicator by coincidence of two unrelated scales.

style.indicator.edge.note: [R] for the flush inset — there is no offset token; the indicator sits on the bottom edge of the tab per m3.material.io. NOTE the skeleton's base gives the slide mechanism `right: auto` at higher specificity so the measured inline width wins.

style.indicator.shape.source: active-indicator-shape on the primary tab — the mark's TOP corners are rounded to its own height, which only reads correctly because the mark sits at the bottom of the tab. The secondary file has NO such token; material-web's tokens/_md-comp-secondary-tab.scss supplies `'active-indicator-shape': 0` in _add-missing-secondary-tokens(), carried by style.indicator.emphasis@secondary.

style.indicator.rest.note: [R] — with the slide mechanism there is one indicator element and it is painted only while a tab is selected

style.indicator.background@hover.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — M3's hover feedback is a state layer on the tab, not a preview of the mark. Salt is alone in previewing it.

style.indicator.selected.source: active-indicator-color -> md-sys-color.$primary, the same value in both emphases

style.indicator.transition.note: [R] — CONFIRMED ABSENCE of any motion token on either tab file. Borrowed from docs/foundations/motion.md's medium2 (300ms) + standard easing, the same principled placeholder tooltip.m3.json and dialog.m3.json used. Depends on structure.indicator-motion = slide; if that cell flips to static this one switches off.

style.indicator.emphasis@secondary.source: secondary's active-indicator-height 2px [S, generated token] and active-indicator-shape 0 [S, material-web's own _add-missing-secondary-tokens()]

style.tab-icon.size.source: with-icon-icon-size 24px, identical in both files and both editions — half again the size of shadcn's 16px and twice Salt's medium 12px

style.tab-icon.color.note: M3 DOES declare a full parallel icon-colour family — eight tokens on primary, five on secondary — but every one resolves to the same role as the label colour in the same state (on-surface-variant inactive, primary/on-surface active, on-surface hovered/focused/pressed). A currentColor glyph is therefore not an approximation but the identical output, and thirteen duplicate rows are avoided. Recorded so a future reader does not add them.

style.panel.box.note: CONFIRMED ABSENCE — no panel token in either file; see the no-panel-token provenance note

state.focus-visible.note: VALUES CHANGED BY THE v0.192 PIN. The ring is now 3px solid md-sys-color.secondary at outline-offset 0px, sourced from tokens/_md-comp-focus-ring.scss ($width / $color / $inward-offset) rather than from the tab's own focus-indicator family, which is `latest`-only — the offset moved from -3px (inset) to 0px (flush). The focus state layer moved from 10% to 12% (versions/v0_192/_md-sys-state.scss focus-state-layer-opacity). See style.tab.focus and provenance.focus-ring.
